name: aim-instagram-suite
description: Codex plugin for AIM Instagram Suite content-team orchestration and per-slide carousel image generation.

interface.shortDescription: Create Instagram content teams and per-slide carousel image prompts.
interface.longDescription: AIM Instagram Suite adds MCP-powered content strategy and carousel creation workflows to Codex. It includes a content-team skill for strategy, hooks, scripts and visual direction, plus a carousel image-agent skill that generates every slide as a separate image prompt without collages.
defaultPrompt: Create an Instagram carousel from this brief.
Build a content plan with AIM Content Team.
Generate each carousel slide as a separate image.
